mkvtoolnix.purpose: Identify Matroska tracks/attachments (mkvmerge --identify) and copy embedded text subtitles and font attachments unconverted into a rebuildable cache (mkvextract); G09.2, G15.5, G15.7, G19.1. Optional runtime dependency
mkvtoolnix.license: GPL-2.0-only (MKVToolNix; COPYING). Bundled libraries retain their own licenses as listed in the release README (Qt 6 LGPL-3.0, ICU, GLib/GnuTLS/libtasn1 LGPL-2.1+, Nettle/GMP/libidn2/libunistring LGPL-3.0+ or GPL-2.0+, Boost BSL-1.0, FLAC/Ogg/Vorbis/PCRE/cmark BSD-style, p11-kit BSD-3, libffi MIT, libdvdread GPL-2.0+)
mkvtoolnix.sourceCompleteness: MKVToolNix source is published upstream at the URL above. Complete corresponding sources of the AppImage-bundled third-party libraries have not been collected; like the BtbN FFprobe build, the Linux files are for local and experimental container use only, without public image publication

linux-amd64.checksumVerification: Upstream publishes no SHA256 for AppImages. The zsync control file states SHA-1 ccfb9bb167b50ef4cb433a697e17b33d507daefd and length 62746600; the HTTPS download matched both on 2026-10-04 and its SHA256 was then calculated and pinned here
linux-amd64.extraction: Selected regular files are read by scripts/squashfs_reader.py (pure Python, bounded); the AppImage runtime, AppRun and FUSE are never executed
linux-amd64.runtimeRequirements: glibc >= 2.28; libstdc++, zlib and GMP are not bundled and come from runtimePackages; glibc from mediaRuntime

windows-amd64.checksumVerification: SHA256 copied from the official sha256sums.txt on 2026-10-04; the downloaded archive re-hashed to the same value
windows-amd64.runtimeRequirements: Windows 10 or later; statically linked executables

mediainfo.purpose: Supplement Matroska/WebM probes with chapter titles, attachments and container tags (G19.1). Optional runtime dependency

mediainfo.checksumVerification: MediaArea publishes no checksum files for these archives. Both were downloaded over HTTPS from mediaarea.net on 2026-10-04 and their SHA256 calculated and pinned here; the license text is byte-identical in both
